## Review and integration

A fresh read-only reviewer submits a structured exact-head/base verdict through
the queue. Code or base changes invalidate that verdict. Policy/security,
destructive migrations, production deployment and model promotion also need a
non-author human approval. Do not include credentials, private data or weights.

Opening this PR means Review; completion requires successful merged-main checks.
